notes.title: Demo v2
notes.content:
Completely overhauls the game flow!!
The open world has a lot of direction, there's an actual boss, and the game has a completely next complexity to the game. Give the demo a try and let me know what you think!

[list]
[*] The open world now has paths. Choose between movement and attack paths to build your decks the way you want. At the end of the paths is a portal to take you back to the starting area, where you choose to fight the boss or venture back out
[*] There's now only one hand, and you only start with movement cards. Discard movement cards to draw attack cards
[*] A slew of rewards out in the open world
[*] All vendors cost money to use
[*] New Queen Maker vendor - Allows you to turn cards into queens
[*] Most vendors now have either attack or movement types to them for more precise options
[*] Made it so only two levels are open, a forest level and a snow level. The forest level has enemies with double attack, and the snow level has enemies with double health
[*] Forest boss has art and a special attack
[*] Special enemies spawn in different levels
[*] Card art
[*] Boss music
[*] Sound effects
[/list]

The game is still considered in prototype phase while I play around with core gameplay elements. I think following this update there will either be a v3 prototype, or I will work on polishing things up and have a "finished" game up to two levels. More info coming in the future!
